verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm next-day and 2-day expedited direct deposit payroll alongside standard 4-day processing, plus regular/off-cycle payroll runs via APIs, satisfying the core story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of fast direct deposit specifically for standard (non-embedded) Gusto SMB customers, and community evidence notes a $60k cap and eligibility exceptions needed for 2-day payroll, indicating real-world limits.
